locked_decisions.summary: Coverage is measured against declared roots. Workspace-level coverage is not provable by any tool.
locked_decisions.invalidation: Decision 4 makes the ABSENCE of request_status from a paginated list response a hard error. Observed live at Notion-Version 2026-03-11: the field is absent from every normal response (data_sources query has_more true; block children has_more true; block children has_more false). The primary reference documents it as CONDITIONAL, emitted at the 10,000-result cap, with the prescribed test being positive: request_status.type === 'incomplete'. As written, decision 4 hard-errors every healthy scan. Decisions 1, 2, 3, 5 stand. Do NOT edit ADR-0002.
locked_decisions.still_standing: Coverage is measured against declared roots. An unreachable declared root is a hard coverage failure exiting 2. Every unresolvable reference is an explicit observation. The report states start and end times.

locked_decisions.summary: SARIF 2.1.0 as output-contract design source, SonarQube issue-lifecycle as state machine. SARIF is an export target later, not a v0.1 schema commitment.
locked_decisions.superseded_parts: Decision 2 (four-valued outcome enum), decision 3 (`incomplete` fails the run), and the final Consequences paragraph (the SARIF coverage claim). The file was NOT edited — ADR-0005 supersedes those three parts by reference. Decisions 1, 4, 5, 6 stand.
locked_decisions.still_standing: Finding identity is the Notion object ID. Observation/finding split from OSCAL. Baseline entries are never counts. Suppressions require a reason and an expiry, with no escape hatch.

locked_decisions.summary: Determinism defined against a named Normalization function. Specify it before the proof runs.

Outcome is a pair — conformity (conforms|violates, absent when nothing was evaluated) × evidence sufficiency (sufficient|unreached|undecidable). `inapplicable` deleted: operator exclusion moves to the scope declaration, precondition mismatch becomes an applicability filter in the manifest. Report disposition unqualified|qualified|disclaimed; a disclaimed report renders no summary verdict. Coverage manifest is a five-stage funnel: declared, resolved, enumerated, fetched, evaluated.
locked_decisions.governing_rule: A value earns its place only if it changes what the operator does next. This is why evidence sufficiency has three values (different remedies) and why ISA 705's `adverse` was dropped (materiality is not computable by a CLI).
locked_decisions.hard_rule: No ratio is published without the coverage figure bounding it. XCCDF's exclude-from-scoring rule applied alone reproduces the Great Expectations defect — success_percent over evaluated expectations lets a half-unrun suite report 100%.
locked_decisions.pervasiveness_predicate: Gaps are pervasive when a declared root was never reached, or any gap is unbounded. Structural, not a percentage: a ratio threshold would be computed over a denominator the scan has just admitted it cannot establish. Generalises ADR-0002 decision 2.
locked_decisions.deviations_from_checkpoint_plan: Five funnel stages, not four — `enumerated` was added between resolved and fetched because it is the only source of unbounded gaps, and the disclaimed disposition keys on those.
locked_decisions.evidential_standing: Decisions 1-3 rest on adversarially re-verified primary sources (ISA 705 paras 5(a) and 17, XCCDF value list, OSCAL metaschema negative, SARIF schema, PCAOB AS 3105.45, ISO 19011 6.5.1 k, Semgrep enum). Decision 5's funnel shape rests on CONSORT 13a/13b, PRISMA 16b and STROBE 13 — fetched but NOT re-verified, adopted on three-way convergence. Re-verify clause numbers before publishing them.

locked_decisions.summary: Truncation is detected by a positive test -- request_status.type === 'incomplete' -- and that test covers ONE endpoint family. The signal is documented on POST /v1/data_sources/{id}/query only. It is absent from /reference/intro#pagination, the normative shared-envelope description, and from GET /v1/blocks/{id}/children. Absence of the field is neither an error nor proof of completeness.
locked_decisions.the_larger_finding: GET /v1/blocks/{id}/children is the traversal spine of the scan and carries NO truncation signal. A complete enumeration and a silently truncated one return the same has_more: false -- the value that lied at the data-source cap before 2026-04-20. Every completeness claim the product makes over page content rests on it. The scan cannot close this; ADR-0006 decision 5 discloses it per-run instead. STRENGTHENED by ADR-0007: this finding rested on documentation silence when written -- the same inference that failed on the search row -- and now rests on notion-sdk-js PR #711 threading request_status through seven named response types and OMITTING ListBlockChildrenResponse. An enumerated omission, not an unchecked silence.
locked_decisions.evidence_sufficiency_ruling: No fourth value. An absent request_status maps to `sufficient`. Rejected on ADR-0005's governing rule -- a value earns its place only if it changes what the operator does next. The absent case has no remedy, fires on 100% of runs, and a permanent universal qualifier is the mechanism ADR-0005's fourth Revisit-if predicts will train readers to skip the limitations half.
locked_decisions.cap_trip: Where a documented cap exists, a terminal count AT the cap makes the enumerated count a lower bound, not an equality: cause suspected_result_limit, marked unbounded, remedy 'partition the declared root'. Transplanted from Elasticsearch hits.total.relation 'gte', the OSIsoft PI Web API documented silent-truncation case, and fetch n+1. Applies to dataSources.query only -- block children and search have no documented cap constant, and building one from the observed ~11,200 search wall is rejected.

locked_decisions.title: Baseline matching is a hierarchy of matchkeys over a resource anchor, not an equivalence relation over fingerprints
locked_decisions.supersedes: ADR-0008 decision 6 -- its matching rule and its key-composition table. ADR-0008 decisions 1-5 and 7 stand, as do decision 6's four SARIF constraints and its two-hazard analysis. ADR-0008 not edited.
locked_decisions.restores: ADR-0003 decision 1, which ADR-0008 decision 6 drifted from without citing it
decisions: 1. Identity is two layers: anchor = (rule ID, resource ID) on the native object ID, normalized to hyphenated UUIDv4 on ingest; discriminator = matchkey hierarchy scoped inside one anchor
2. The hierarchy runs as ordered passes over sets, not as a probe per finding -- a pass is a set join and has no visiting order
3. Matching is one-to-one; a matched pair leaves the pool (Wray 2024)
4. Transitive closure is prohibited -- the failure it forbids is over-merging
5. Ties inside a pass are broken by a published total order; a rule without one does not ship
6. The observed value is evidence, never identity -- this is what makes `updated` reachable
7. Key list v1 for all four shipping rules; n=0 and n=1 are valid hierarchies

open_decisions.detail: Four formal literatures apply to this product and none has been opened across nine ADRs: certain-vs-possible answers in incomplete-information databases (ADR-0005's outcome pair is a folk re-derivation), transaction isolation and phantom reads (UNQ001 is phantom-prone by construction and may return conforms over a workspace holding a duplicate), unseen-population estimation (ADR-0005 decision 3 asserts an unbounded gap cannot be sized without consulting the field that sizes unobserved populations), and entity resolution (where issue #31's defect is a standard result).
open_decisions.unseen_population_ANSWERED: SWEPT 2026-08-17, recorded at docs/research/unseen-population-sizing.md. ADR-0005 decision 3 SURVIVES, and its stated reason should be replaced rather than kept. The field agrees no upper bound is available in the general case (Alfo, Bohning & Rocchetti 2020, DOI 10.1111/biom.13265; Mao, Huang & Zhang 2016, DOI 10.1111/biom.12553). Every estimator that does produce a bound -- Chao1, ACE, jackknife, Good-Turing, Horvitz-Thompson -- runs on a FREQUENCY-OF-FREQUENCIES distribution and needs the same unit observed more than once. Cursor pagination returns each child exactly once, so singletons equal n and doubletons are zero by construction: the input does not exist. These estimators also assume the miss is RANDOM; a cursor stops at a deterministic prefix. UUIDv4 IDs rule out the serial-number family. NEW REVISIT-IF: two independent enumerations of one scope over identifiable IDs WOULD give a frequency-of-frequencies distribution -- the project has two paths, block-children and POST /v1/search (#24). DO NOT USE IT: both share one permission grant, so the lists are positively dependent, and positive dependence biases the estimate DOWN, reporting a SMALLER gap than the true gap. That is the flattering direction and the product's own false-green class inside the coverage instrument. Incidental: Bar-Ilan & Peritz 2009 DOI 10.1002/asi.21097 independently reaches ADR-0006's 'partition the declared root' remedy. Four of eight quotes verified against Crossref abstracts; four rest on a Wiley retrieval tool and are marked unverified in the file. ACM and IEEE venues NOT CHECKED, not absent.

open_decisions.detail: Called in S009, not yet ADR'd. Core type is provenance, not Page: Observed<T> = complete | partial+cause | unreachable, with NO function Observed<T> -> T, and combinators that propagate partiality so that unique over a partial list cannot return true. One adapter seam is the only code permitted to construct an Observed. Language: TypeScript, because the official SDK's types are the request_status source of truth and give drift detection at tsc time; the Rust fuzzing NEVER-rule does not fire because JSON over HTTPS is not in its named class.
open_decisions.next: Validate by prototype rather than by ADR. Does Observed<T> stay ergonomic or poison every call site?

open_decisions.detail: CONTEXT.md defines the applicable set as a set of RESOURCES and ADR-0005 decision 4 defines the coverage ratio the same way, but REF001's applicable set is a set of internal references (glossary term: Edge) and UNQ001's is a set of property values across a scope, which is neither. Three options: widen the word to `subject`, make the unit a per-rule declaration, or leave each spec to state its own denominator in prose (the current state, and the one to argue against explicitly). CONTEXT.md is a living doc and is corrected in place; ADR-0005 is not edited.

open_decisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-08-17 by ADR-0011, MERGED to main in PR #38 at 88d401e. Option 2 -- each rule declares its own coverage item. SYS001 resources, REF001 internal references, REQ001 (resource, required property) pairs, UNQ001 unordered pairs of resources in a uniqueness scope. The coverage ratio is a vector; the headline is the minimum, never a mean. Issue #36's own table was wrong about REQ001 and ADR-0011 corrects it. #36 is CLOSED.

open_decisions.detail: Whether 'a rule's applicable set is derived from what the API returned, never from the subset the tool knows how to handle' binds every rule and needs an ADR, or is a consequence of ADR-0005 decision 5 honestly applied. Two independent observed instances in one run (results-ref001-live.md sections 2 and 3) plus the soundiness manifesto. Do not settle by asserting the stronger option because it feels safer.

operator_rulings: No ghostwriting. Produce content specifications for anything he will send as himself, never drafted first-person copy. The literal-humanist-voice register governs how the agent writes; it does not license writing as him.

Citations are receipts, 2026-08-17. A claim carries a locator a third party can follow -- ADR, repo file plus section, official API doc, commit SHA, dated post. Paraphrase without a pointer, 'as we discussed', 'Notion's docs say', 'the ADR covers this' -- all commentary, not evidence. In a system treating UNMEASURED and claim ceilings as first-class, the citation is the only mechanism keeping the ceiling honest.

The gap is rigour, not triage, 2026-08-17. 'The real hole here is in lack of rigor, computer science research, and systems design analysis - not ticket triage.' Proved the same session by issue #31: a merged ADR adopted a matching rule that is not an equivalence relation, and no template, PR review or hook caught it. Check formal properties before writing the evidence section.

Notion Workers and the PAT are not v0.1 surfaces, 2026-08-17. The PAT is ruled out by Principle 7 -- its API capability is a single bundle including create and update, with no read-only variant -- so the planned PAT fixture test in #27's DoD is NOT to be run. Workers are technically viable via an integration token and strategically premature: no exit byte, both output shapes reopen a stated boundary, Business/Enterprise only, and billed since 2026-08-11 on a per-run credit meter that charges more the more completely the scan reads.
